review_cost.rationale: Approve with comments: a short list of nits plus one architectural discussion (caching model) that doesn't block the merge.

findings.issue: All six pages export dynamic = 'force-dynamic' and caching is hand-rolled in lib/api.js; Next 16.4 recommends Cache Components (use cache / cacheLife) for every app and removes the dynamic config when it's enabled (default in Next 17).
findings.suggestion: Plan a migration to cacheComponents and replace the hand-rolled memoization with use cache + cacheLife, or at minimum document the deliberate choice and expect churn at the Next 17 upgrade.

findings.issue: The global Map cache has no size bound, TTL, or eviction; move and pokemon records are large, so memory grows unboundedly over the process lifetime.
findings.suggestion: Bound it (LRU with a byte or entry cap) or let the framework's cache with cacheLife own it.

findings.issue: No error.js / global-error: a non-404 API failure (500, network blip) renders Next's default error page with no recovery path.
findings.suggestion: Add an app/error.js boundary with a retry link.

findings.issue: getPokemon is dead code; the Pokémon page fetches the variety URL via raw fetchJson instead.
findings.suggestion: Delete getPokemon or use it in loadPokemonPage for consistency.

findings.issue: MISSING is redefined locally while lib/format.js exports it, and the typeLabel lookup closure is duplicated in three pages.
findings.suggestion: Import MISSING from lib/format and move typeLabel into lib/format or a small helper next to getTypeLabels.

findings.issue: Row keys include the array index, weakening reconciliation if rows reorder under sorting.
findings.suggestion: Key by moveHref plus level (both are stable within a table).

findings.issue: router.replace builds the query string by hand and would silently drop any other query params present on the URL.
findings.suggestion: Read existing searchParams and merge, or use router.replace with a search-only object so future params survive.

findings.issue: prefetch={false} on every link in the app disables partial prefetching and instant navigations for all users.
findings.suggestion: Drop prefetch={false}; with Cache Components (or even now, shells are cheap) prefetch improves navigation feel. If cost is the concern, scope it to card grids only.

findings.issue: A server-only constant (MEDIA_BASE_URL) is exported from the data layer and imported by a shared component, creating an implicit server/client boundary that breaks if the card ever becomes a client component.
findings.suggestion: Pass media base via props/context or move the constant into a leaf config module free of server logic.

summary: This is a well-organized, genuinely readable App Router app that I'd merge with comments rather than rework. The one architectural conversation it invites is that it's built entirely on the legacy rendering model — per-page force-dynamic plus a hand-rolled global fetch cache — which Next 16.4 has begun retiring in favor of Cache Components, so expect migration work before Next 17. Correctness is solid; the only structural risk worth acting on soon is the unbounded process-lifetime cache.
